ActiveModule().details: triggered when owner try to blacklist the active module.

NotImplemented().details: triggered when a function logic is not implemented.

AddressZero(string).details: triggered when an address that should not be zero is equal to address zero.

NoHandoverRequest().details: The `pendingOwner` does not have a valid handover request.

ArrayNotSameLength().details: triggered when two arrays suppposed to have the same length, have different length.

WithdrawNotAllowed().details: triggered when setModule action try to remove funds.

NotWhitelistedBeacon().details: triggered when whitelisting action is occuring and module's beacon is not whitelisted on module registry.

NewOwnerIsZeroAddress().details: The `newOwner` cannot be the zero address.

PositionNotInitialized().details: triggered when setModule function end without initiliazePosition call.

OnlyManager(address,address).details: triggered when the caller is different than the manager.

NotWhitelistedModule(address).details: triggered when owner try to blacklist a module that has not been whitelisted.

ModuleNotEmpty(uint256,uint256).details: triggered when all tokens withdrawal has been done during a switch of module.

NotPositionInitializationCall().details: triggered when the first external call of setModule function isn't InitializePosition function.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

devdoc.details: This contract implements a proxy that gets the implementation address for each call from an {UpgradeableBeacon}. The beacon address is stored in storage slot `uint256(keccak256('eip1967.proxy.beacon')) - 1`, so that it doesn't conflict with the storage layout of the implementation behind the proxy. _Available since v3.4._

constructor.details: Initializes the proxy with `beacon`. If `data` is nonempty, it's used as data in a delegate call to the implementation returned by the beacon. This will typically be an encoded function call, and allows initializing the storage of the proxy like a Solidity constructor. Requirements: - `beacon` must be a contract with the interface {IBeacon}.
